public_bundles.observation: Page-specific bundles include itemInfoSku/selectors and tracking components; actual catalog payload already server-embedded. Bundle strings include unrelated shipping/coupon/cart APIs; no SKU-JAN endpoint is established by static source review. This is not proof that the live browser makes no additional requests.

application_json_scripts.purpose: point calculation UI settings; contains NCP benefitsCalculation endpoint/config, not product-result or SKU records

search_page_hydration_addendum.jsonld: One ItemList with Product name/image/offer price/aggregate rating/url; no JAN/articleNumber observed.
search_page_hydration_addendum.per_result_html: Initial cards expose shopId, itemId, data-track-itemid, one data-track-variantid and item URL. No articleNumber or all-variant SKU array observed in search HTML.
search_page_hydration_addendum.bundle_review: Captured page-specific bundle references /search/mall routes, UI filters, and shared api-ichiba-gateway.rakuten.co.jp/graphql-common-bff/graphql string. No statically identified search-result API returning articleNumber/JAN or full variant records. Bundle strings do not prove absence of runtime requests; live network trace belongs to separate capture.

warning: Static findings and initial successful example, not all31page browsertraffic. Availability observations from this phase are superseded by later HTML coverage.
